verdict.reasons: The candidate successfully displays the required AFP white-and-blue upright cylindrical drip-tape carton. The branding is authentic, readable, and consistent with the provided owner-approved sleeve captions. The scene correctly depicts a wheat crop with continuous, thin flattened drip-tape laterals, aligning perfectly with the article's technical focus on 20 cm drip tape spacing and root-zone wetting. The product stands separately on the soil with a visible gap, avoiding the core defect of using packaging as operating plumbing. Minor visual imperfections such as the composite white background and the 'cutout' style of the soil bed are advisory and do not preclude a passing score, as the product identity and technical evidence are clearly maintained.

No protruding white ribbon, strap, or tape tail is visible emerging from the carton sides or base.
